verdict.rationale: Clerk documents an official remote MCP server that agents such as Claude, Cursor and GitHub Copilot can connect to. It offers SDK snippets plus account tools for managing applications, users and production instances, a one-command CLI connection, and OAuth client registration via CIMD and Dynamic Client Registration. A probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect and work smoothly in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Clerk provides a remote [Model Context Protocol (MCP)](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/introduction) server that allows AI agents like Claude, Cursor, and Github Copilot to access Clerk SDK snippets and implementation patterns.
Account tools: Create and configure applications, manage users, and set up production instances in your Clerk workspace.
Connect the Clerk MCP server to your AI clients in one command, so your agent works with up-to-date Clerk SDK snippets.
Clerk supports both Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD) and Dynamic Client Registration for OAuth client registration.
